summary: The Great Pyramid is ~146.6 m tall and ~230 m per side, composed of ~2.3 million blocks (avg ~2.5 tons); to finish within Khufu's ~27-year reign requires placing roughly one block every ~2-3 minutes on average.
content: The Great Pyramid of Giza, built c. 2560 BCE as Khufu's tomb, rises ~146.6 m over a ~230 m-per-side base and comprises ~2.3 million blocks... Finishing it within Khufu's ~27-year reign implies ≈1 block every ~3 min on average across the project.
